name: io.github.tonyyang0504/dhgate_open-mcp
description: DHgate (敦煌网) + DHgate Open Platform (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_product, quote_shi

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DHGATE_OPEN_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: App Key of your DHgate Open Platform application (https://open.dhgate.com/console); the Dropshipping/buyer APIs must be granted to the app (API authorization level A, no public network access).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DHGATE_OPEN_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: App Secret of the application, sent in the refresh_token grant to https://secure.dhgate.com/dop/oauth2/access_token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_DHGATE_OPEN_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Refresh token from the DHgate BUYER account's authorization-code consent (https://secure.dhgate.com/dop/oauth2/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=…&scope=basic, then grant_type=authorization_code). It is valid 30 days; the runtime mints 1-day access tokens from it and keeps the refresh_token each response returns (set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to persist it).
